item.title: Central bank holds interest rates steady, signals cuts later this year
item.description: The central bank kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged on Monday and signalled that cuts could follow later this year as inflation cools.

item.title: Coastal flooding closes two highways after overnight storm
item.description: Two coastal highways were closed early Monday after an overnight storm brought flooding to low-lying stretches of the coast road.

item.title: City council approves funding for new stadium roof
item.description: The city council voted to approve funding for a retractable roof on the municipal stadium after months of debate.
